name: Greatest Athletes
description: The athletes most often called the greatest, from Babe Ruth and Pelé to Muhammad Ali, Michael Jordan, Serena Williams and Messi.

checkpoints.name: The early champions
checkpoints.note: The modern Olympics open in 1896, Thorpe, Ruth, Owens and Bradman become national heroes, and sport begins to be a stage for politics.

checkpoints.name: Postwar icons
checkpoints.note: Zátopek and Bikila stretch what runners can do, Robinson breaks baseball's colour bar, Ali becomes a voice beyond boxing, and Pelé wins three World Cups.

checkpoints.name: The television years
checkpoints.note: Comaneci's perfect ten, Maradona, Jordan and Navratilova play for audiences of millions, Gebrselassie wins distance titles and Tendulkar carries cricket-mad India, and sponsorship turns champions into global brands.

checkpoints.name: The record breakers
checkpoints.note: Bolt, Phelps, Serena Williams, Federer, Nadal, Messi, Kipchoge and Biles push records in the sports where the margins are smallest.
